properties.name: The workflows' GitHub Actions move to their current majors: checkout v7, upload-artifact v7, download-artifact v8, docker/login-action v4, docker/setup-buildx-action v4
properties.rationale: Approved-queue item (b) of the 2026-10-01 dependency audit (fact:dependency-audit-2026-10-01-the-full-sweep), its own PR, proved before merge by a dry_run dispatch of release.yml on the branch: run 36965158231, green. It exercised checkout v7, upload-artifact v7, download-artifact v8 by name, setup-buildx v4 and the image smoke gate on both architectures. docker/login-action v4, the digest upload and the pattern downloads in `container image` and `publish release` are gated off in a dry run and run first at the next real tag. tools/test_release_workflow.py: 8/8.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: actions/checkout v5 → v7, actions/upload-artifact v4 → v7, actions/download-artifact v4 → v8, docker/login-action v3 → v4, docker/setup-buildx-action v3 → v4 in ci.yml and release.yml. All five run on Node 24. No breaking note applies to how these workflows call them: downloads are by name or pattern (never by ID), setup-buildx takes no inputs, and no step pushes or reads git credentials. download-artifact v8 fails on a digest mismatch where v4 warned.
